Reduced Latency

Enhances response times for smoother online experiences

Scale your network with Optical Network Terminal (ONT)

With the Optical Network Terminal (ONT), you can customise and scale your home network by pairing it with our WiFi 7 router / mesh or choose to use own from your existing set up.

Depending on the XGSPON high-speed internet plans: HomePac 3Gbps internet - Max Speed of 3Gbps / HomePac 10Gbps internet -  Max Speed of 10Gbps.

To get XGSPON speeds of up to 10Gbps internet in Singapore, you'll need the following:

  • • M1’s XGSPON high-speed broadband plan at 3Gbps or higher

  • • XGSPON-compatible ONT issued by M1

  • • Compatible router on Wifi 7 (802.11be) standard

  • • Devices (e.g. mobile phones and computers/laptops) capable of supporting XGSPON speeds

Useful tip: To make the most of a 10Gbps broadband connection on a laptop or computer, you need a 10Gbps network adapter and a CAT6 cable. Speed will still be dependent on the end device's capacity and specifications.

What are the FAQs About Home Broadband Plans?

Why do I need M1’s XGSPON High-speed Fibre Broadband?

With more high-bandwidth applications like 4K streaming, online gaming, and remote work, you’ll need a plan that can keep up. M1’s XGSPON High-speed Home Internet Plans (3Gbps and above) offer true symmetrical speeds to meet all your needs.

Are routers provided for M1’s XGSPON High Speed Plans?

For our ONT 10Gbps plan, you have the flexibility to go without a router or choose to top up for the latest Wi-Fi 7 devices if needed.​

What are M1’s XGSPON High-speed Plan offerings?

M1’s latest XGSPON High-Speed Home Internet Plans offer 10Gbps speed. The XGSPON standard represents the most advanced technology available for residential fibre broadband from an internet service provider in singapore

How does XGSPON compare to GPON?

XGSPON offers faster speeds of up to 10Gbps compared to GPON's 2.5Gbps and is built to handle higher data traffic, making it more suitable for future data demands.

What is XGSPON standard?

XGSPON (10 Gigabit Symmetric Passive Optical Network) is a next-generation fibre broadband technology that delivers symmetrical internet speeds of up to 10Gbps for both uploads and downloads.

Benefits of XGSPON standard home broadband plans include:

  • Ultra-Fast Speeds: Delivers higher broadband speeds ideal for bandwidth-intensive applications.
  • Increased Capacity: Supports more users and devices simultaneously
  • Reduced Latency: Enhances response times for smoother online experiences.
What is the typical speed for M1 Fibre Broadband Plans?

Typical local download speed for Fibre Broadband is 10Gbps (2870.86 - 8215.35Mbps). Typical local upload speed for Fibre Broadband 10Gbps (4595.28 - 8094.25Mbps).

The typical speed range refers to the range of download speeds that users can experience 80% of the time based on the specific test conditions and parameters which are stipulated on m1.com.sg/typicalspeed. Testing Time Frame: April to June 2026.

Where can I sign up for M1 Home Broadband?

You can sign up for M1 Home Broadband through any of the following channels:

 

  • Online: Sign up via our online store here.
  • M1 Shops: Visit any of our M1 Shops.
  • M1 Fibre Broadband Retailers: Visit one of our authorised M1 Fibre Broadband Retailers.
Who should I contact if I need technical support for my Fibre Broadband connection?

If you are facing connectivity issues, you can reach out to our technical support team by calling 1627.

Alternatively, you can request a house-call appointment through the M1+ app (under “More” tab > “View/Request appointments”)

Frequently Asked Questions About M1’s Home Fibre Broadband Plans

What is the best fibre speed for home use?

The best broadband plan M1 offers in Singapore is the 10Gbps plan, which will offer you the highest priority traffic-wise while gaming, streaming or even connect to multiple devices especially in your smart home.

 

For those looking for home office broadband or have larger families that do a decent amount of streaming simultaneously, we highly recommend the 10Gbps fibre broadband plan. No fibre home broadband plan out there provides better value for money than our bundle promotion.

Casual users can opt for the 3Gbps fibre home internet plan; you’ll enjoy seamless browsing at highly affordable price.

How do I choose a fibre broadband plan?

The optimal way to determine which is the best fibre broadband internet plan for you is to gauge your home internet usage. Once you’ve done that, you can then compare M1’s home broadband plans in Singapore and go with the one that meets your needs.

However, if you’re looking to make the switch to the best internet service provider in Singapore due to a desired increase in speed, opt our high-speed fibre broadband plans and give your plan a boost with a next-gen Wi-Fi router or a Wi-Fi mesh system to get rid of any Wi-Fi dead spots.

How do I sign up for a broadband plan with M1?

Signing up with Singapore’s best fibre optic home broadband service provider really couldn’t be easier! Simply compare our home internet plans and choose the one that will work best for you. No worries if that’s all you’re after - just follow the prompts, browse all the fantastic broadband add ons we have available, and complete the sign-up process. As we’re also one of Singapore’s leading internet telephone providers, be sure to take advantage of our great internet telephone deals and promotions too! Switching landline providers is easy, and you can keep your existing landline number when you make the switch.

What are the FAQs About Home Broadband Plans?
Why do I need M1’s XGSPON High-speed Fibre Broadband?
With more high-bandwidth applications like 4K streaming, online gaming, and remote work, you’ll need a plan that can keep up. M1’s XGSPON High-speed Home Internet Plans (3Gbps and above) offer true symmetrical speeds to meet all your needs.
Are routers provided for M1’s XGSPON High Speed Plans?
For our ONT 10Gbps plan, you have the flexibility to go without a router or choose to top up for the latest Wi-Fi 7 devices if needed.​
What are M1’s XGSPON High-speed Plan offerings?
M1’s latest XGSPON High-Speed Home Internet Plans offer 10Gbps speed. The XGSPON standard represents the most advanced technology available for residential fibre broadband from an internet service provider in singapore
How does XGSPON compare to GPON?
XGSPON offers faster speeds of up to 10Gbps compared to GPON's 2.5Gbps and is built to handle higher data traffic, making it more suitable for future data demands.
What is XGSPON standard?
XGSPON (10 Gigabit Symmetric Passive Optical Network) is a next-generation fibre broadband technology that delivers symmetrical internet speeds of up to 10Gbps for both uploads and downloads.
Benefits of XGSPON standard home broadband plans include:
Ultra-Fast Speeds: Delivers higher broadband speeds ideal for bandwidth-intensive applications.
Increased Capacity: Supports more users and devices simultaneously
Reduced Latency: Enhances response times for smoother online experiences.
